description: MantleOS is the phone app for a Mantle brain, the self-hosted AI memory you run on your own server. Chat with your assistant, search everything, notes, pages, tasks, journal, files and events. No Mantle server yet? Enter https://demo.mantle-ai.tech on the first screen and sign in with any email and password; the demo is read only.
whatsNew: Up next on the home screen shows your next events and the tasks that are due. Tap a notification to go straight to the event or task it is about, on the right login. Alarm taps now open their event on iPhone too.
